def execute_lucky_seven_xenoblade(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Noah's special sword can be drawn to unlock unusually powerful combat Arts.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    assert allowed_combat_state(actor)
    play_attack_animation(actor,ability)
    during_active_frames: targets = sweep_weapon_or_body_hitbox(actor)
    for target in new_valid_targets(targets,hit_ledger): resolve_melee_hit(target)
    on_recovery_complete: disable_hitbox_and_finish()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
